args.title: Fix: re-raise exceptions in get_or_compute instead of swallowing them
args.body:
## Problem
`get_or_compute` was silently catching all exceptions from the `compute` function and returning the previous cached value (`_last`). This meant failures were invisible — dashboards showed stale data with no indication anything had gone wrong.

## Fix
Changed the `except Exception` block in `src/cache.py` to re-raise the exception instead of swallowing it. This ensures callers see the error immediately and can handle or log it appropriately.

## Change
```python
# Before
except Exception:
    return _last   # BUG: swallows the error silently

# After
except Exception:
    raise
```

## Tests
- `test_compute_failure_contract`: now passes — `ValueError` is propagated as expected
- `test_returns_computed_value`: continues to pass — normal compute path unaffected
